## AI Interview Copilot (MVP) — Flutter + FastAPI

This repo contains:

- `backend/`: FastAPI server (PIN profiles, resume/JD ingestion, RAG retrieval, answer generation, interview WebSocket).
- `mobile/`: Flutter app source (PIN login, setup, interview mode UI).  
  **Note**: Flutter is not installed on this machine, so the platform folders (`android/`, etc.) are generated by you with one command.

---

## Backend (FastAPI)

### 1) Setup

```powershell
cd C:\Users\XEEDO\Desktop\Work\Cursor\ai_interview_copilot\backend
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 2) Configure environment

Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill values.

### 3) Run

```powershell
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs`.

---

## Mobile (Flutter)

### 0) Install Flutter (required)

Install Flutter SDK and ensure `flutter` works in a new terminal:

```powershell
flutter --version
```

### 1) Generate platform folders

```powershell
cd C:\Users\XEEDO\Desktop\Work\Cursor\ai_interview_copilot\mobile
flutter create .
flutter pub get
```

### 2) Run on a device

```powershell
flutter run
```

### 3) Build APK

```powershell
flutter build apk --release
```

The APK will be under `mobile/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/`.

---

## What works in this MVP

- Local **4-digit PIN** creates/unlocks a local profile.
- Setup stores:
  - **Voice enrollment** (recorded audio file uploaded; server stores a placeholder voiceprint hash for now).
  - **Resume** (PDF/DOCX/TXT supported; server extracts text best-effort).
  - **Job description** (paste or upload).
- Interview Mode:
  - Mic audio streamed to backend over WebSocket.
  - Backend emits:
    - `interviewer_text` (live transcript)
    - `suggested_answer` (single updated suggestion; no chat history)

### Providers

- **Transcription**: You can enable Deepgram streaming (recommended) via env vars.
- **LLM**: Uses OpenAI via env vars; if not configured, returns a deterministic fallback answer stub.
